Complete a bounded independently derived readability wave with linked comparisons and one combined verifier. Do not import external source expression.
Investigate all three named hybrids, attempt independent PURE_C conversion, record concrete blockers and retry conditions. Exact hybrid is not PURE_C completion.
Resolve 372-byte complete pose owner, not only exact 364-byte body. Preserve all eight W5 pending targets and four already accepted stubs.
Qualify all eight boundary candidates through caller/shared-data evidence; include or exclude only with supported reviewed membership evidence.
Resolve renderer call runtime-owner ambiguity before making family claims.
Enumerate and classify jump-table destinations; current exact source does not close discovery by itself.
Identify selector function-pointer/data consumers, especially func_00201778; resolve func_00208DC8 registration target live 0x800EA604. Reassess unresolved interfaces and stream/carrier integrations.

Audit/review owner-start-plus-four placement entry before converting held owners; preserve three callers and six call instructions.
Review complete logical owner across p2449 and p2450 before encoded-item writer conversion.
Use accepted prefix/tail mechanism, validate 136-byte original prefix, 24-byte compiler table, eight-byte tail in data_00197738. Draft has no linked proof.
Close both auxiliary interfaces; review four retained route interfaces together before movement conversion.
Research supply controller choice/timing and two branch helpers before their source wave.
Research the three candidate terrain-policy helpers before conversion.
Preserve unnamed finalizer return stored at source-record +0x18 and map-unit flag 0x00020000; new semantic names require supporting research.
Resolve complete scripted/site owner scope and benefit before release. Nine deferred owners, two core site owners, and broad hybrid remain visible. A deferral is not completed source work.
Retain all 97 external target dispositions, direct-data exclusions and indirect-call limits; reinspect affected boundaries when accepted source invalidates them.
Reattempt five retained HYBRID_C owners using new compiler/lifetime or neighboring-source evidence. Do not repeat exhausted sweeps without new hypotheses.
Finish B438 saved-register cycles and reestablish B894 production proof using accepted table/provenance capabilities; one complete eight-member W5 gate.

Preserve seventeen owners. Reauthenticate fourteen provisional sources; finish B1F4 and D14C; activate EF50 only after reviewed combined production partition. Map four dispatch modes; resolve shared prototypes.
Preserve terminal owner 9284-byte head plus 988-byte continuation as one 10272-byte logical owner. Use accepted complete-owner mechanisms; never activate nonexact dossier source.
Attempt SUPPORTED_ALIAS evidence for every matched function; insufficient names do not block matching. CANONICAL replacement requires stronger evidence.
Director audits every requirement against final generated proof; hybrids/exceptions remain explicit. No publication authority follows from this assignment.
